ValidationRule.description: A pending row with no approver is invisible to everyone and can never be decided — it just sits there looking submitted. Before R3 that was reachable whenever the Account snapshot was null. Refusing the state is what makes the approver ladder honest: if it cannot resolve anyone, the submit fails loudly instead of producing a row nobody will ever see.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This invitee cannot be submitted: no approver could be determined. Set a Manager on the submitting user, or ensure the Account or Lead has an owner other than the submitter.
